description: Checkmyguest offers you an elegant 54m² apartment ideally located in the prestigious Faubourg-du-Roule district. Nestled near the illustrious Arc de Triomphe, this space offers the perfect balance between modern comfort and prestigious location. With its 2 refined bedrooms, this apartment is designed to offer an exclusive residential experience in the heart of the capital.The spaceLocated in the heart of the prestigious Faubourg-du-Roule district, this contemporary and modern apartment can accommodate up to 7 people, ideal for families or groups wanting an authentic experience in Paris.Faubourg-du-Roule is renowned for its chic and cosmopolitan ambiance, with its tree-lined avenues, luxury boutiques and elegant cafés. In the immediate vicinity, you will find a multitude of fine restaurants, trendy bars and high-end fashion boutiques, creating a lively and dynamic living environment.Inside, discover: ➜ A spacious living room with a comfortable sofa bed, ideal for relaxing after a busy day. ➜ A first bedroom featuring a double bed and a single bed on a mezzanine, perfect for families with children or friends travelling together.➜ A second bedroom equipped with a queen size bed, ensuring optimal comfort.➜ An elegant dining area where you can enjoy meals with family or friends, in a friendly and pleasant atmosphere.➜ A fully equipped kitchen including a hob, kettle and all the utensils needed to prepare delicious meals.➜ Two modern bathrooms with shower and toilet completing the facilities and ensuring comfort and convenience for all residents.➜ Numerous optimized storage spaces to organize your belongings.⇄ Television and high-speed Internet (WIFI).➜ Bed linen and towels are provided by us.Guest accessYou will have access to the entire apartment, so you will feel at home.O
